visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a simple black-and-white line-drawn animation of a white dog-like character with floppy ears and large expressive eyes on a plain white background. The character has a light blue rectangular highlight across its eyes and is waving its right paw. (2) A quick cut shows three cartoon characters—a mouse, the dog, and a rabbit—looking determined with thick eyebrows and gritted teeth. Bold black characters '啟動' appear on screen. (3) The dog character appears in a full shot, walking confidently to the left while carrying a roll of white toilet paper under its left arm. Bold black characters '啟動' are centered behind it. (4) A screen-in-screen YouTube player appears, showing a real-world video of two young men outdoors near a riverfront. The man on the left wears a purple durag and black t-shirt, while the man on the right (Ray) wears a black bandana. The animation character watches from the foreground. (5) An animation of a white commercial airplane with 'Supermarket' written on a sign above the dog character's head follows. The dog is seen inside various stores like a supermarket and a department store with racks of clothes and shelves of apples. (6) The scene shifts to an elevator lobby. The dog character stands by a closed elevator door, looking at a white smartphone. The digital floor indicator displays red numbers (1, 2, 3...) sequentially. (7) The elevator door opens to reveal a middle-aged woman with curly hair and a purple jacket. Both the dog and the woman are depicted with dramatic shadows on their faces, conveying shock and tension. (8) The final scene shows the dog and woman face-to-face in a hallway; the dog waves awkwardly with sweat droplets around its head while the woman waves back simply.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male narrator speaking Mandarin with a warm, casual tone over a bright, acoustic guitar-driven pop BGM. (2) A sharp percussive hit SFX occurs simultaneously with a loud vocal shout of 'Qi Dong', marking a sudden increase in intensity. (3) The BGM continues as the narrator resumes a conversational pace, explaining office culture. (4) A second percussive hit SFX accompanies a shouting voice 'La Shi Qi Dong' with high vocal arousal. (5) The narrator's speech rate increases slightly as he introduces the Ray meme. (6) A loud, distorted audio clip from the Ray viral video plays, featuring two men shouting 'Kua Sa Siao I want it all' with extremely high arousal and loudness. (7) Several rapid 'whoosh' and 'impact' SFX follow as the narrator describes a shopping montage. (8) A soft 'ding' SFX mimics an elevator chime. (9) The narrator's tone shifts to a hesitant, lower pitch as he describes the elevator encounter. (10) A final loud shout 'Kua Sa Siao' occurs followed by a deliberate 1-second pause of strategic silence to emphasize the awkward encounter. (11) The audio concludes with the narrator laughing gently and summarizing the moral of the story over the fading acoustic BGM.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to entertain and warn viewers about the social consequences of overusing aggressive internet memes in real life by sharing a humorous and relatable story about a 'failed' attempt to use a slogan in front of a neighbor.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The animation style is minimalistic, focusing on expressive facial gestures to drive the humor. The contrast between the high-energy meme audio and the low-energy awkward silence at the end is a key comedic device.
